only_changed_leaves.before: Wide shot in a walled London garden at grey evening light, one adult English householder in a plain 1660s wool coat points toward distant fire beyond low red-brick gabled rooftops, his intact house visible beside him and his face in three-quarter view
only_changed_leaves.after: Wide establishing view from a walled London garden in 1666, one middle-aged English householder with a short beard and receding hairline, wearing a plain knee-length coat, appears head to toe as a small figure on the left and points over the wall toward a distant orange fire glow beyond narrow gabled rooftops; an intact brick house stands beside the garden under a soft overcast sky
